<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Diagnosed defect (assets/inputs/omp-extension-delivery-findings.md, file:line receipts): DeliveryService publishes message.pushed even when the computed outcome is Queued (crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:298-322); PushedEvent carries NO job_id (:527-539) while ack requires the claimed job_id (:30-38, :340-413). The pi/omp extension therefore injects the full body (rust-runtime.ts:104-123 → session.ts:589-600) but cannot ack, the row stays live, and the pointer worker announces it (pointer/worker.rs:292-327) because uds can_deliver rejects non-Claude harnesses. Observed live: omp got the body at transcripts/accept-omp-lark-%2167.txt:145 and the pointer at :153. URGENCY: after s122 the unacked row will TYPE the body a second time — the duplicate gets worse.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- One message = one delivery for a pi/omp seat: body injected once, no pointer, no retype
- The consumer can ack what it took — job_id (or an equivalent claim handle) reaches the extension with the pushed event
- The daemon never announces/types a row an extension consumer has legitimately taken
- Wire change is additive and skew-safe: an OLD extension against a NEW daemon must not lose delivery, and a NEW extension against an OLD daemon must not double-ack (state which direction fails loudly and prove it)

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Event-stream cursor + reconnect/replay (the SECOND defect in the same findings doc — its own unit, own witness)
- Claude socket path and s121 consent stamping
- Widening uds can_deliver to non-Claude harnesses (that is the pi-extension transport question, not this seam)
